home.title: Intelligent <services>software</services> for real <work>ideas</work>.
home.intro: Hantari is a software & AI studio. We help businesses, organisations and people with an idea go digital, modernise the software they rely on, automate the manual work and add AI where it earns its place.
home.featureTitle: From manual work to software that runs itself.
home.servicesIntro: One small team, from the first conversation to the software running in your business.
home.lactaText: A bilingual website for a lactation consulting practice — services, reviews and resources the owner runs herself, with booking and an AI assistant on the way.
home.approachTitle: We build carefully, explain plainly, and keep things running after launch.
home.step1Title: Start with the work, not the tech.
home.step1Text: We map how things run today and where time is lost, then agree on what “better” means.
home.step2Text: Working versions early and often, so you’re never guessing what you’re paying for.
home.step3Text: Hosting, monitoring and updates handled — the people who built it look after it.
home.ctaTitle: Have a process that eats your week?
home.ctaText: Tell us what it is. We reply within 1–2 business days with a clear next step.

about.title: A small studio for practical software.
about.intro: Hantari is a software & AI studio based in Timișoara, Romania, working with people everywhere. We help businesses, organisations and independent makers go digital, bring older software up to modern standards, automate the manual work — and use AI where it solves a real problem, not where it makes a good headline.
about.p1Text: We explain what we’re building and why, in words you’d use yourself.
about.p2Text: Success is time saved and errors avoided — not a longer feature list.
about.p3Text: Solid infrastructure, sensible security and support after launch.
about.p4Text: Small, steady improvements beat big-bang rewrites.

start.title: Tell us what you’d like to fix.
start.intro: Three short steps, about two minutes. No technical knowledge needed — describe it the way you’d explain it to a colleague.
start.next1: You get an email confirming we’ve received your request.
start.next2: Within 1–2 business days we reply with questions or a first idea.
start.next3: If it’s a fit, a short call — then a clear written proposal.
start.s1Title: What do you need help with?
start.s1Text: Pick one or more. Not sure? That’s fine too.
start.s2Text: A few sentences is plenty. What happens today, and what should happen instead?
start.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. We track orders in a spreadsheet and email three people every time one changes. It takes hours each week and things get missed.
start.toolsPlaceholder: e.g. Excel, Gmail, an old in-house app, SmartBill…
start.timeline: When would you like to start?

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNote: Draft — to be reviewed before launch and completed with the company’s legal details once registered.
privacy.s1Text: Hantari is a software & AI studio based in Timișoara, Romania. You can reach us at hello@hantari.ro.
privacy.s2Text: When you send a request through our “Start a project” form, we collect the details you enter: your name, email, and optionally your company and phone number, plus what you tell us about your project.
privacy.s3Text: Only to reply to your request and, if we work together, to prepare a proposal. We do not sell your data or use it for marketing without your separate consent.
privacy.s4Text: Requests are stored in a database hosted in the EU and delivered by email through our email provider. We keep them for up to 24 months, then delete them.
privacy.s5Text: We only use a strictly necessary cookie that remembers your language choice. No advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s6Text: You can ask us at any time to see, correct or delete your data by writing to hello@hantari.ro. You also have the right to complain to the Romanian data protection authority (ANSPDCP).
